overview_description.description:
ClearView MD is a predictive analytics firm that is powering the transition to value-based care by providing health systems interventions that lead to higher patient and staff satisfaction, lower costs, and the ability to treat more patients. ClearView MD identifies inefficiencies on client's workflows, and recommends steps to improve your scheduling, staffing, and facility utilization.

The company was founded by Rajiv Sivendran and Artur Menzeleev, with headquarters in Boston, Massachusetts.

product.name: Workflow Core
product.description: A real-time patient flow management system that displays patient status and location, helping to manage room occupancy and cleaning status.

product.name: Scheduling Core
product.description: A scheduling solution that creates optimized patient scheduling templates to reduce wait times and improve clinician workdays.

product.name: Analytics Core
product.description: A data-driven analytics tool that measures and analyzes clinic operations to identify and resolve bottlenecks and optimize workflows.

product.name: Real-Time Location System (RTLS)
product.description: A system using Bluetooth Low Energy sensors to track the location of patients, staff, and equipment in real-time.
